title: Best local image -> 3D model + texture generator?
author: Josef-Witch
selftext:
I have finished a large 3D adventure game using Meshy.ai for assets. It has confirmed for me, like Adobe did years ago, that I never want to depend on art-making tools that require me to pay, login, and be connected to the internet.

Any local generators or workflows that come close to Meshy for image -> 3D with textures?

I'm comfortable with Comfy UI, but have experienced a lot of breakages with local AI workflows and wouldn't mind a true GUI if available.

Thanks

replies.author: justifun
replies.body: Doesn't work on windows yet and requires a 24gb vram card.

replies.author: VirusCharacter
replies.body: Works now (W10 and W11 confirmed with 5090 and 5080)

comments.author: Olmeca_Gold
comments.body: 3d generators are very large models. There are less than 10 model families out there. There is no open source model you can locally use.

replies.author: Josef-Witch
replies.body: Well, Hunyuan 3D exists for example. Open source, 6gb VRAM requirements for model generation. I've used it locally but it's a year old and feels dated compared to current online tools

replies.author: shutonga
replies.body:
where did you download the model?
Which webUI? Comfy?

replies.author: JhonRock_
replies.body:
So from where did you get that model and how do you did it?

comments.author: spacespacespapce
comments.body: Not fully local - but I am using local models like Kimi-K2 and Qwen for my Blender [builder](https://nativeblend.app/)

replies.author: Josef-Witch
replies.body: This looks interesting, thanks. You made this tool? I really like how it models procedurally as opposed to the dense mesh point clouds of other methods

comments.author: Tiny_Habit5745
comments.body: Local is though. Maybe Hunyuan? I've been using 3daistudio for a while and not local but it's been working great... 3d generator models are though, I don't think I could run one locally even if I tried

comments.author: hansolocambo
comments.body: [Hunyuan 3D v3.1](https://3d.hunyuan.tencent.com/) is free. You just need an email, and get 20 models per day (per mail, so basically unlimited). And it blows away any other I've tried.

comments.author: Minute_Coast_4222
comments.body: Hitem3D. I’ve actually been using it lately to generate NPCs for my game. It outputs high-res textures and handles lighting well.
